summary: Praxis Precision Medicines filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) to disclose that the FDA extended the PDUFA target action date for its relutrigine NDA by three months to December 27, 2026, after the submission of additional sensitivity analyses was deemed a major amendment. No new clinical studies were requested, and no safety or manufacturing concerns were cited. This is an ordinary regulatory update on an ongoing NDA review, not a special situation event. The registrant is the filer. No deal terms, board actions, or structural changes are involved. Watch for the FDA's final decision in late December.
